scanner_c.notes: Curated from fresh Sep 21-22 public-web reporting across the U.S., China/Hong Kong, Taiwan, Europe and global markets, prioritizing Reuters and concrete technology, macro, M&A and capital-markets catalysts relevant to U.S.-equity investors. Distinct events only; no trivial padding.

items.event_title: Alibaba unveils Zhenwu V900 AI chip and targets more than 20GW of data-center capacity by 2032
items.news_summary: Alibaba unveiled the Zhenwu V900 AI chip, outlined a much larger next-generation AI model and said Alibaba Cloud data-center capacity should exceed 20GW by 2032; shares rose about 5%.
items.investor_materiality: Direct read-through to China AI compute, cloud capex, Nvidia competition, foundry/memory/networking demand and BABA valuation.
items.selection_reason: One of the clearest fresh AI semiconductor/cloud catalysts in the 24-hour window with an identifiable stock reaction.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report from Alibaba's Apsara conference with company statements and market reaction.
items.youtube_query: Alibaba BABA Zhenwu V900 AI chip
items.video_angle: 阿里突然亮出中国最强AI芯片：真正要挑战的不是模型，而是英伟达+云计算的整条利润链。

items.event_title: Meta Muse adoption reignites AI trade after an 11% stock surge
items.news_summary: Meta's new Muse AI assistant drew strong adoption and helped drive Meta up more than 11%, its biggest one-day gain since April 2024, while lifting broader AI-linked equities.
items.investor_materiality: A mega-cap product catalyst with implications for Meta monetization, consumer AI distribution and the wider AI equity complex.
items.selection_reason: Large news-driven move in a mega-cap well above the scanner's normal materiality bar and a clean consumer-AI monetization story.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters global-markets and Wall Street coverage ties the move directly to Muse adoption and AI optimism.
items.youtube_query: Meta META Muse AI assistant stock
items.video_angle: Meta暴涨11%不是财报：Muse为什么可能第一次让华尔街相信Meta的AI烧钱能变现？

items.event_title: Paramount settles state and union lawsuits, clearing a major hurdle for Warner Bros. takeover
items.news_summary: Paramount reached settlements with U.S. states and a union over its Warner Bros. Discovery takeover, removing a major legal obstacle to the roughly $110 billion transaction.
items.investor_materiality: Material deal-completion catalyst for PSKY/WBD with direct implications for merger probability, spreads, leverage and media consolidation.
items.selection_reason: Concrete M&A/legal catalyst with a direct change in deal probability rather than generic merger commentary.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage is represented in Scanner B evidence; additional major outlets including WSJ, NYT and CBS reported the settlement.
items.video_angle: 1100亿美元并购突然更接近完成：WBD这次上涨到底是在交易什么概率？

items.event_title: AI rally sends AMD to $1 trillion market value while Intel and Arm surge
items.news_summary: The Nasdaq closed at a record as AI enthusiasm returned; AMD rose about 10% to reach a $1 trillion market value for the first time, Intel gained 12.2% and Arm 17%, while the SOX index jumped 4.3%.
items.investor_materiality: Large synchronized moves across major semiconductor equities indicate a major repricing of AI compute expectations.
items.selection_reason: Exceptional magnitude across multiple large-cap chip names and a new valuation milestone for AMD.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters U.S. market close with explicit price moves and market-cap milestone.
items.youtube_query: AMD Intel Arm AI rally September 2026
items.video_angle: AMD第一次摸到1万亿美元：为什么这轮AI反弹Intel和Arm反而涨得更猛？

items.event_title: Taiwan August export orders exceed $100 billion for first time on AI demand
items.news_summary: Taiwan's August export orders reached a record and topped $100 billion for the first time, led by strong global AI demand.
items.investor_materiality: High-quality upstream demand signal for AI chips, servers, networking and electronics supply chains including TSMC and U.S. semiconductor names.
items.selection_reason: Official-economy data offers a concrete cross-check on whether AI infrastructure demand is still accelerating.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report citing Taiwan economy ministry data.
items.youtube_query: Taiwan export orders AI demand semiconductor
items.video_angle: AI泡沫还是实单？台湾出口订单第一次破1000亿美元给了一个很硬的答案。

items.event_title: Taiwan breaks ground on advanced-packaging park anchored by TSMC
items.news_summary: Taiwan broke ground on a Kaohsiung advanced-packaging industrial park where TSMC plans technology-validation and talent-training facilities.
items.investor_materiality: Advanced packaging remains a key AI accelerator bottleneck, making new ecosystem capacity relevant to TSMC, Nvidia, AMD and packaging-equipment suppliers.
items.selection_reason: Concrete physical capacity/ecosystem expansion in one of the most constrained parts of the AI semiconductor chain.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting on the official groundbreaking and TSMC role.
items.video_angle: AI芯片真正卡脖子的不是晶圆？台湾又建一个先进封装园区，TSMC在抢什么。

items.event_title: Oura targets $15.6 billion valuation in U.S. IPO
items.news_summary: Smart-ring maker Oura launched its U.S. IPO roadshow targeting a fully diluted valuation of about $15.62 billion and up to roughly $2.2 billion in proceeds for selling shareholders.
items.investor_materiality: A large consumer-tech listing tests IPO demand and valuation appetite for wearable/health-tech assets.
items.selection_reason: Large identifiable IPO with a valuation above $10 billion and a clean public-market pricing catalyst.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters transactional reporting on the IPO roadshow and valuation target.
items.video_angle: 一个智能戒指凭什么值156亿美元？Oura IPO是在测试AI穿戴设备的估值上限。

items.event_title: Fed officials keep further rate hikes in play as oil and inflation stay elevated
items.news_summary: Fed officials including Alberto Musalem and Austan Goolsbee signaled additional tightening may be needed; markets put high odds on another hike as oil and inflation pressures persist and 10-year yields remain near 5%.
items.investor_materiality: Direct discount-rate catalyst for growth stocks, bonds, gold, dollar and equity multiples.
items.selection_reason: Fresh policy guidance immediately after a rate hike with broad cross-asset consequences.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters market reporting quoting Fed policymakers and current rate-market expectations.
items.youtube_query: Fed rate hikes oil inflation September 2026
items.video_angle: AI股又创新高，但10年美债还在5%附近：市场为什么敢同时交易AI狂热和继续加息？

items.event_title: ECB launches Pontes blockchain settlement link to financial markets
items.news_summary: The ECB launched Pontes, linking central-bank payment infrastructure to blockchain-based markets so transactions can settle in ECB-backed euros; Deutsche Bank, Santander and Clearstream are among early participants.
items.investor_materiality: Important market-infrastructure step for tokenized securities and bank adoption of blockchain settlement in Europe.
items.selection_reason: Concrete central-bank infrastructure launch rather than speculative crypto commentary.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters finance report describing the live ECB service and participating institutions.
items.youtube_query: ECB Pontes blockchain settlement Deutsche Bank
items.video_angle: 欧洲央行真的把区块链接进金融系统了：这和炒币完全不是一回事。

items.event_title: Ahead of Trump-Xi meeting, investors continue funding both sides of the AI divide
items.news_summary: Reuters found U.S. banks have underwritten 19 Chinese tech deals worth $17.2 billion this year while Chinese funds increased exposure to U.S. semiconductor equities, highlighting deep capital links ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting.
items.investor_materiality: Directly relevant to semiconductor capital flows, China tech listings, export controls and geopolitical risk premia.
items.selection_reason: Fresh data-driven angle on the U.S.-China AI relationship immediately before a major bilateral meeting.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters analysis with quantified underwriting and investment-flow data.
items.youtube_query: Trump Xi AI investors US China semiconductor
